name: Relocate to a lower-tax state
description: The downsize plan plus a change of residency: `state_change` switches the state tax module from June 2031, and `expense_change` scales the whole living baseline by 0.85 for a lower cost of living. Only VA, SC and NC are modeled — this example moves VA → SC. Compare against downsize-cash to separate what the move saves in tax from what it saves in spending.
